title: Flank Steak Salad
description: Flank steak is a relatively inexpensive cut of beef, low in fat, and nicely chewy, making it a good fit for this broccoli salad with a tasty dressing. It’s an easy and pretty dish to bring to a summer outing.
ingredients: Of course, you can eat the steak and broccoli separately, too. Yum!
directions: To marinate the steak, whisk together Worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, oil, garlic, and sugar in a shallow dish or heavy Ziploc bag. Add steak, turning to coat, and marinate at room temperature 15 minutes or up to 4 hours in the refrigerator.
If you’ve refrigerated the meat for several hours, be sure to bring it back to room temperature before cooking it.
For the salad dressing, whisk together chopped shallots, vinegar, mustard, olive oil, 1 teaspoon salt, and ½ teaspoon pepper in a large bowl or serving dish.
Prepare a gas grill for cooking over medium-high heat.
Bring a pot of salted water to boil. Cut the broccoli into bite-sized serving pieces and cook in the boiling water until done, but still crisp, about 3 to 5 minutes.
After draining, plunge the broccoli into some iced or cold water to stop the cooking.
Drain again and mix the broccoli with the red peppers and enough salad dressing to generously coat.
Grill steak, covered, turning once, 8 to 10 minutes total for medium-rare.
Pat steak dry and season with ¼ teaspoon each of salt and pepper. Oil the grill rack.
Or, grill in a hot, lightly oiled grill pan on the stovetop over medium-high heat, 9 to 11 minutes total, turning once.
Transfer steak to a cutting board and let rest, uncovered, 5 minutes.
Thinly slice steak across the grain and then into bite-sized pieces.
Toss steak with the broccoli salad, maybe adding a little more dressing and salt to taste.
Eat now, or later at room temperature.
